✅ Professional Realistic Watercolor Procreate Brushes – Complete Painting Studio

Create stunning, authentic-looking watercolor illustrations with the Complete Watercolor Painting Studio for Procreate! This collection has been meticulously crafted to mimic the organic textures, natural blending, and rich pigment of traditional watercolor paint.

Whether you are a professional illustrator or just beginning your digital art journey, these essential tools provide everything you need to achieve professional results right on your iPad. No complicated setup is required—simply import the files and start painting immediately!

✅ This Realistic Watercolor Pack Includes:

14 High-Quality Watercolor Brushes: (.brushset) Featuring various textures from fine-point details to broad, atmospheric washes.

6 Magic Canvases: (.procreate) Perfectly textured to simulate professional cold-press paper surfaces for instant realism.

Two High-Resolution Canvas Sizes: iPad Standard (S) and iPad Large (L); 6364×4500 px and 4243×3000 px at 300 DPI.

64 Curated Color Palettes: (.swatches) A massive library of hand-picked colors for a realistic artist’s setup.

8 Ready-to-Use Sketches: (Transparent PNGs) Perfect for quick-start inspiration and practice.

Detailed User Guide: (PDF) Simple instructions for a quick and easy installation.

✅ Compatibility:
Specifically designed for Procreate 5 or newer on all iPad models that support the app.
